Measured: Emulated S9+ landscape (846 x 411/340/300), hatchback, manual, stalled: one finger on Restart was refused with a keyboard hint ('clutch down (z) or neutral to start'); with the clutch held at 1.00, the tap on Restart fired 0 click events, so no restart. After the fix: one finger gets 'Hold the clutch, then tap Restart'; clutch held restarts at 586-780 rpm at all three heights.

Cause: The hint was a line in the middle column, and the dials' row could shrink below its content (min-height: 0), so on a short screen the column spilled into the strip.
